issues.title: Local embedding model makes Obsidian unresponsive while indexing
issues.body: With the local model enabled the app locks up for minutes on a 4k-note vault. Expected indexing to run in the background. M1 Air, 16 GB.
issues.author: jtwaleson

issues.title: Renaming a folder triggers full re-embedding of the vault
issues.body: Every rename invalidates embeddings for all notes under it. Would love content-hash based reuse so search stays usable.
issues.author: kepano_fan

issues.title: Incremental reindex instead of rebuilding the whole index
issues.body: Rebuilding 12k chunks takes 4 minutes. Could we only embed changed files and patch the index?
issues.author: hbrndt

issues.title: WASM backend: embedding 50k chunks blocks main thread even in a worker
issues.body: Using feature-extraction with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 in a Web Worker, the tab still janks while persisting results to IndexedDB. Looking for guidance on batching.
issues.author: rn_notes

issues.title: RAG lookup adds 100+ ms per turn with hosted vector DB
issues.body: Our retrieval processor calls a hosted vector store each turn; p95 is 140 ms. Is there a recommended in-process retriever for latency-sensitive pipelines?
issues.author: dsmurrell

issues.title: Document a low-latency retrieval pattern for voice agents
issues.body: The RAG example hits an external vector DB on every turn. For phone calls this adds noticeable dead air. A local index example would help.
issues.author: lsorber

issues.title: WASM build: loading a 200 MB vector table on startup is slow
issues.body: In a Tauri app the first query waits ~3 s while the table loads. Is there a lazy or mmap-style option for the WASM build?
issues.author: hbrndt

issues.title: Edge runtime: embedding model cold start adds ~700 ms
issues.body: Running a small embedding model in an edge route reloads weights on every cold start. Any pattern for caching or precomputing?
issues.author: edgecase_io

readmes.Minitour/semlocal:
# semlocal

Local semantic search for your notes. No server, no vector DB.

```
npx semlocal index ~/vault
npx semlocal search "notes about retrieval latency"
```

## Why
Obsidian and plain-markdown users want meaning-based search without shipping notes to an API.

## Roadmap
- [ ] Incremental reindex (#41)
- [ ] Obsidian plugin
- [ ] WASM build for the browser
readmes.hbrndt/tauri-notes-search:
# tauri-notes-search

Offline semantic search for a Tauri notes app.

- Embeddings: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 via WASM
- Storage: sqlite-vec

## Known issues
Startup takes ~3 s on large vaults while the vector table loads.
